lessonTitle: 61. Areas and volumes with mixed numbers
lessonTitleEnglish: Areas and volumes with mixed numbers
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 5 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: A rectangle's sides can be mixed numbers; its area is still S = a · b.
stages.headlineEnglish: A rectangle's sides can be mixed numbers; its area is still S = a · b.

stages.headline: A square's area is a · a; with a mixed side the area may be a mixed number too.
stages.headlineEnglish: A square's area is a · a; with a mixed side the area may be a mixed number too.

stages.headline: The volume of a box is V = a · b · c with mixed numbers as well.
stages.headlineEnglish: The volume of a box is V = a · b · c with mixed numbers as well.

stages.headline: A square has side 1 1/3 cm. What is its area in cm²?
